trial_title: Cervical Intraepithelial Neoplasm (CIN)-Warts Efficacy Trial in Women (Gardasil)(V501-013)(COMPLETED)
brief_summary: The primary purpose of the study is to determine if GARDASIL (V501) with four components is able to prevent cervical cancer, cervical dysplasia, including Cervical Intraepithelial Neoplasia (CIN)(Any Grade) and Adenocarcinoma In Situ (AIS), and genital warts.

eligibility_table.criterion: Female with an intact uterus with lifetime history of 0-4 sexual partners
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has a history of multiple male partners, which exceeds the maximum of 4 sexual partners required for inclusion.

eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient received at least one dose of the Gardasil HPV vaccine prior to the current evaluation?
Has the patient had ≥1 prior abnormal Pap smear results documented in her medical history?
Has the patient ever been diagnosed with genital warts by a healthcare professional?

attention_flags: EXCLUSION UNCLEAR: Prior Human Papillomavirus (HPV) vaccination
EXCLUSION UNCLEAR: History of genital warts
LOW INCLUSION MATCH: only 0 of 1 inclusion criteria met
